[When I'm not on my computer]{.running-eyebrow}

I discovered my love of running while pursuing my undergraduate degree
at Clark University, where I joined the varsity cross-country team (NCAA
DIII) initially as a way to make new friends. Over the course of my time
at Clark, I improved enough that with my remaining eligibility, I was
able to compete for the University of Maine (NCAA DI) cross-country and
track teams for the first year and a half of my PhD. I am now continuing
to train and race alongside my research.

## Selected highlights

### University of Maine

- Outdoor 5000m school record holder (15:59), breaking a 14-year-old
  mark
- NCAA East Regional qualifier in the 5000m and 10,000m
- 2026 America East indoor 3000m champion and IC4A/ECAC 5000m champion
- Seventh at the 2025 America East Cross Country Championships, helping
  Maine secure its first conference title in program history
- Three-time Elite 18 Award recipient for the highest GPA among
  All-Conference finishers

### Clark University

- School record holder in the women’s outdoor 5000m and 10,000m and
  cross country 6km
- Female Athlete of the Year in 2024–25 and 2022–23
- Clark’s first qualifier for the NCAA Division III Cross Country
  National Championships
